label: Diagram 3.15
caption: Diagram 3.15 Floor type 2.2B(b) – floor type 2.2 with ceiling treatment B and floating floor (b)
description: The drawing is a section, marked "SECTION" at the bottom right, beneath the title "Diagram 3.15 Floor type 2.2B(b) – floor type 2.2 with ceiling treatment B and floating floor (b)". It shows a vertical cross‑section of a floor/ceiling assembly in layers. At the top is a horizontal band filled with a speckled or stippled texture, underlain by a thin band of vertical hatching. Below this is a horizontal structural member drawn as a long block containing a row of evenly spaced circles, broken at both ends to indicate continuation. From the underside of this member, a small hanger symbol hangs by a short line at the centre, with a thin vertical line descending from it. Beneath the member is a separate lower layer consisting of a horizontal line at the bottom spanning the full width, a horizontal line at the top that is present only at the left and right ends and broken in the middle, and a band of closely spaced zigzag or spring‑shaped symbols in the middle, occupying the space between the two lines. A single arrow from the label "Timber batten" points upward to the bottom horizontal line. No other dimensions or figures are given.
